name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites and Zucchini
ingredients_verbatim: 1 pound sirloin steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
why: Whole-muscle sirloin steak bites seared with zucchini in garlic butter - in-lane (steak, not ground), structurally low-carb (meat + fat + non-starchy veg, no rice/pasta/potato). Published nutrition 563 cal / 9g carb / 53g protein per serving sits mid-band on calories and well under the 35g carb ceiling. Sirloin maps to board sirloin-steak, zucchini to zucchini; garlic/butter/salt/black-pepper/lemons all on board. Scales cleanly to 14 by weigh-and-divide skillet batching.
